COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
16.06.2026 WPMB No.500 of 2026
Basant Ballabh Punetha … Petitioner
Vs.
State of Uttarakhand & Anr. … Respondents
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Gupta, C. J.
Hon’ble Subhash Upadhyay, J.
1. Mr. Shobhit Saharia, learned counsel for the 
petitioner. 
2. Mr. J.C. Pande, learned Standing Counsel for the 
State.
3. Mr. S.S. Chauhan, learned counsel for respondent 
nos.2 and 3.
4. The contention is that the petitioner had submitted 
work experience certificate dated 08.04.2026 which 
evidences experience of execution of two works of value 
₹ 79,61,137.00 and ₹ 28,80,586.25, total value being is 
₹ 1,08,41,723.28. He submits that since the petitioner 
had worked as sub-contractor, therefore, as per the 
certificates issued at page 165 and 167, the petitioner 
would be entitled to benefit of 25% of the total value of 
the component relating to hill side cutting which is more 
than 1/3rd of the total value of hill cutting i.e. 
96,12,788.00 specified in the bill of quantity. Thus, the 
rejection of the bid of the petitioner in the technical 
round for not having the experience of hill side cutting is 
manifestly illegal. 
5. The matter requires consideration. 
6. Shri S.C. Chauhan, learned counsel for respondent 
nos.2 and 3 prays for time to obtain instructions. 
7. Let the instructions be obtained within a week. 8. List on 30.06.2026.
9. Shri S.S. Chauhan, learned counsel for respondent 
nos.2 and 3 undertakes that in the meanwhile the 
contract shall not be finalised. 
(Subhash Upadhyay, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, C.J.) 
 16.06.2026 16.06.2026
Rajni

COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
7 WPMB No. 500 of 2026
Basant Ballabh Punetha .…… Petitioner
Vs.
State of Uttarakhand and others ……Respondents
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Hon’ble Siddhartha Sah, J.
Mr. Shobhit Saharia, Advocate for the 
petitioner.
Mr. B.P.S. Mer, Standing Counsel for the 
State.
Mr. S.S. Chauhan, Advocate for the 
respondent nos. 2 and 3.
Learned counsel for the respondent nos. 2 
and 3, under instructions, submits that the 
experience certificate which was given to the 
petitioner by BRIDCUL PMGSY Head Quarter, 
which is Annexure 8 to the writ petition is not 
correct. He further submits that, in fact, the 
petitioner does not fulfill the condition of NIT 
because he has not got the experience of hill 
cutting to the extent of 1/3rd of the BoQ of the 
instant case. He has rendered for the perusal of 
the Court certain instructions.
Learned counsel for the petitioner seeks 
time to peruse those instructions so that he 
may get further instructions.
List on 07.07.2026 as fresh.
Till 07.07.2026, respondents may proceed
further pursuant to the NIT, but the contract 
shall not be finalized.
(Siddhartha Sah, J.) (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 30.06.2026
Jitendra
